sloka: वज्रालयं वैश्रवणालयं च सूर्यप्रभं सूर्यनिबन्धनं च।ब्रह्मासनं शङ्करकार्मुकं च ददर्श नाभिं च वसुन्धरायाः ।। ६.७४.६० ।।
transliteration: vajrālayaṁ vaiśravaṇālayaṁ ca sūryaprabhaṁ sūryanibandhanaṁ ca।brahmāsanaṁ śaṅkarakārmukaṁ ca dadarśa nābhiṁ ca vasundharāyāḥ ।। 6.74.60 ।।

translations.english: He saw Kailas, the rocks of Himalayas, that way on the Rshaba the foremost Lord Siva, the golden mountain, and the great mountain on which grew, glowing medicinal herbs.
